lessons.symptom: Multiple open issues, agents, watchers or outcome obligations independently own the same root-cause remediation.
lessons.rootCause: Preflight compared titles or local task scope instead of semantic root cause, canonical owner and dependency graph before creating a new obligation.
lessons.failedApproach: Create another remediation issue or agent because the local task wording differs, while the same root cause already has an active owner.
lessons.requiredAction: Refresh current obligations before create; reuse or update the canonical remediation owner for the same root cause and represent separately useful outcomes only as explicit dependencies.
lessons.prevention: Exactly one canonical remediation owner per root cause; successor ownership requires an explicit handoff or supersession decision.
lessons.evidenceRule: A new remediation owner is allowed only when fresh inventory proves no equivalent owner exists or explicit successor evidence supersedes the previous owner.
